reviewer: Writer10 contracts subagent; same-session independent visual review
method: Every page rendered with Poppler at 120 dpi, JPEG quality 82, and visually inspected. Exact SHA-256 checked before each page group. pypdf strict structural inspection supplemented visual review. No manuscript/source/evidence changes.
renderingStorage: Initial ENOSPC required in-memory inspection. After space became available, all 20 images were also retained under output/pdf-qa/initial-page-*.jpg, rendered from the same exact PDF bytes at the same settings. This directory is excluded from the source archive.

structural.remoteUrlReachability: Not re-fetched in this visual QA; checks concern actual URI annotations and pinned source references.

findings.finding: Reproduction commands render/extract –mode and –out as U+2013 instead of literal ASCII --mode and --out.
findings.impact: Copied commands will not invoke the documented flags.
findings.recommendation: Use verbatim commands or disable hyphen ligatures in monospaced text; verify PDF text extraction preserves ASCII --.

findings.finding: Section 4 heading is alone at the bottom of page 4; subsection and body start on page 5.
findings.recommendation: Keep section heading with following subsection and body.

findings.finding: Section 8 heading is alone on page 14 with substantial white space; subsection/table begin on page 15.
findings.recommendation: Keep heading with subsection/table, or explicitly begin the section on a fresh page.

findings.finding: Several paragraphs split after one initial line; page 11 also begins with a single final line from the registry paragraph.
findings.recommendation: Apply club/widow control and recheck pagination. Specific starts: p2 NFT paragraph, p5 complete-clone paragraph, p11 AscensionMark paragraph, p15 World/Policy paragraph.

findings.finding: Justified narrow columns in integration table and claim ledger produce stretched interword spacing and awkward hyphenation.
findings.recommendation: Use ragged-right paragraph columns if compatible with layout.
